summary: Merges text or table contents from multiple input DATs into one DAT for downstream table, script, or text processing.

key_params.name: merge
key_params.note: Merge method for combining input DAT contents

key_params.name: align
key_params.note: How table rows or columns are aligned when merging

key_params.name: fillcells
key_params.note: Fill value for missing cells in table-style merges

key_params.name: language
key_params.note: Common DAT language setting for editor/script context

key_params.name: byname
key_params.note: Append rows or columns by matching names

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: dat
key_params.note: DAT or pattern of DATs to merge

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: unmatched
key_params.note: Append unmatched rows or columns from subsequent tables

common_gotchas: Text and table DATs merge differently; inspect the output shape before driving expressions or exports from fixed cell positions.
Inputs with different row or column counts may require fill values or normalization upstream.
Merge DAT does not parse semantic keys by itself; use JSON DAT, Lookup DAT, or scripts when keys need meaning.
The common DAT language setting affects editor/script context, not the merge algorithm.
key_concepts: Merges text or table DAT inputs into a single DAT.
How selects append, collapse, or replace-cell merge behavior.
By Name changes append behavior to match row or column names instead of pure position.
Spacer and Append Unmatched control collapsed text and unmatched row/column handling.
